unsupported: Idaho Shirtsmith Custom Apparel & Embroidery was founded in 2022 in Nampa, Idaho, by Zack and his team.
The company began as a local shop focused on providing custom apparel and embroidery services to businesses across the state.
Since opening, the team has completed over 1,000 custom orders for more than 100 businesses, operating from a single facility in Nampa.
Customers range from small shops to larger organizations looking for custom uniforms or merchandise.
